E2112

Memory ledger cannot be used: {detail}.

What

Memory ledger cannot be used: {detail}.

Why

`jet audit memory` and `jet fix memory` read one bounded, append-only ledger of exercised GC and unsafe-sentry witnesses; they reject missing or unsafe evidence instead of guessing.

Fix

Run the relevant workload once to create the ledger, or repair the configured `.jet/memory/ledger-v1.jsonl` path, then retry.
